checks.name: perplexity_retired_disabled
checks.what_was_exercised: Deterministic source check that Dogpile records Perplexity as skipped instead of adding a provider call.
checks.proves: The retired paid Perplexity lane is not wired into stage-1 provider execution.

checks.name: tau_provider_boundary
checks.what_was_exercised: Tau skill wrapper doctor and Tau runtime doctor.
checks.proves: Dogpile's required model-orchestration boundary is discoverable and Tau's runtime doctor can execute.
checks.does_not_prove: Full Dogpile synthesis through a Tau provider DAG or the quality of model ranking/summarization.

checks.name: legacy_scillm_fast_lane
checks.what_was_exercised: Legacy Dogpile direct SciLLM fast analysis lane via search_codex_fast().
checks.proves: The current legacy adapter can reach local SciLLM and receive text.
checks.does_not_prove: The desired Tau provider boundary, full Dogpile synthesis through Tau, or provider-specific ranking quality.

checks.name: brave_search
checks.what_was_exercised: Dogpile Brave stage-1 web search through brave-search.
checks.proves: Brave API credentials, query normalization, subprocess call, and result parsing work.
checks.does_not_prove: Deep extraction quality for every Brave result.

checks.name: brave_question_fanout
checks.what_was_exercised: Concurrent Brave question fan-out that replaces retired Perplexity.
checks.proves: Dogpile can ask multiple Brave questions concurrently and receive at least one result set.
checks.does_not_prove: That every generated question is semantically optimal.

checks.name: github_search
checks.what_was_exercised: Dogpile GitHub repo/issues search through gh.
checks.proves: GitHub CLI auth, API access, search commands, and JSON parsing work.
checks.does_not_prove: Deep code search correctness for a selected repository.

checks.name: arxiv_search
checks.what_was_exercised: Dogpile ArXiv stage-1 paper search through the arxiv skill.
checks.proves: ArXiv skill invocation and result parsing work.
checks.does_not_prove: Full PDF extraction for every paper.

checks.name: youtube_search
checks.what_was_exercised: Dogpile YouTube metadata search through ingest-youtube search_videos().
checks.proves: Brave-first YouTube discovery, yt-dlp fallback wiring, and result normalization can return current video IDs.
checks.does_not_prove: Transcript availability for every video, legacy enrichment, or Whisper fallback quality.

checks.name: fetcher_single_url
checks.proves: Dogpile's fetch/deep-extraction primitive can fetch a concrete URL and emit artifacts.

checks.name: feed_pack_security_code
checks.what_was_exercised: Dogpile optional RSS feed pack security_code.
checks.proves: Readable RSS feed monitors work without API keys and parse live items.
checks.does_not_prove: Raw IoC/TIP enrichment feeds or paid/vendor feeds.

checks.name: feed_pack_security_code_extended
checks.what_was_exercised: Dogpile optional RSS feed pack security_code_extended.
checks.proves: Readable RSS feed monitors work without API keys and parse live items.
checks.does_not_prove: Raw IoC/TIP enrichment feeds or paid/vendor feeds.

checks.name: wayback_url_snapshot
checks.proves: Dogpile can query the public archive lookup for a concrete URL.
checks.does_not_prove: Historical truth of arbitrary pages or snapshot content extraction.

checks.name: readarr_nzb_search
checks.what_was_exercised: Optional Readarr/NZB book search through ingest-book.
checks.proves: Configured Readarr/NZB search command can return a parsed result list.
checks.does_not_prove: Local library completeness or book quality.

checks.name: ingest_website_dry_run_handoff
checks.what_was_exercised: ingest-website dry-run handoff against https://example.com with one-page limit.
checks.proves: Dogpile can hand selected URLs to ingest-website without Memory writes.
checks.does_not_prove: Memory storage, QRA quality, or large crawl behavior.
